raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.1.1"

  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  lalburst_version: 3.0.0
  lalframe_version: 3.1.0
  lalmetaio_version: 4.1.0
  lalsimulation_version: 7.0.0

  # LAL requires downstream packages to be built with the same version of SWIG,
  # so we need to pin it here
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lalinspiral-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalinspiral-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 2d3203d775d4d2ea4904e0230170ef3189ed73ac6f8c6925468de9036c358f5c

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalinspiral-c-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - liblalburst >=${{ lalburst_version }}
        - liblalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - liblalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - liblalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: liblalinspiral
    inherit: lalinspiral-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalinspiral*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalinspiral*.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinspiral", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalinspiral >=2.0.1
        - python-lalinspiral >=2.0.1
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalinspiral
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalinspiral
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL Inspiral library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalinspiral
    inherit:
      from: lalinspiral-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalinspiral so that we ensure a unique
        # python-lalinspiral build string for each unique liblalinspiral build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinspiral", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - igwn-ligolw
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinspiral", exact=True) }}
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalburst >=${{ lalburst_version }}
        - python-lalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - python-lalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - tqdm
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalinspiral
            - lalinspiral.inspinjfind
            - lalinspiral.thinca
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
        script:
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALInspiral C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalinspiral` package.

  - package:
      name: lalinspiral
    inherit:
      from: lalinspiral-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalinspiral-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: build-bin
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalinspiral so that we ensure a unique
        # lalinspiral build string for each unique liblalinspiral build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - rsync
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        # help2man runs the Python scripts, which need their runtime dependencies
        - igwn-segments
        - liblal ${{ lal_version }}.*
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinspiral", exact=True) }}
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalinspiral", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - igwn-segments
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinspiral", exact=True) }}
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalinspiral", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalinspiral
          pip_check: false
      - script:
          # assert that the manuals don't just contain errors
          - grep -q ModuleNotFoundError ${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalinspiral_*.1 && exit 1
          # check executables
          - lalinspiral_version --verbose
          - lalinspiral_injfind --help
          - lalinspiral_thinca --help
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalinspiral-user-env.sh" && lalinspiral_version'
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.

about:
  summary: LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library
  description: |
    The LSC Algorithm Inspiral Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LALSuite

  repository: https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/
